strategy_roster.name: Overnight Positioning with EMA
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20) is an explicit fallback because no period is supplied, and a close above it is the long filter; crossing below exits. Market-session clocks and weekend handling are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Previous Candle Breakdown
strategy_roster.notes: The prior candle high/low are represented by shifted Donchian levels, with SMA(20)/SMA(50) as fallback trend filters because no values are supplied. Indents, MA shifts/types, pip protection, and higher-timeframe anchoring are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: BollTrade Bollinger Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: The documented lower-band long reversion is translated with Bollinger(20,2), using a middle-band recross as exit. Band offset, pip protection, volume scaling, and the upper-band short branch are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Trading Tools Library
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA(10)/SMA(30) cross and RSI(14) 60/40 filters are retained; the reverse signal is the long exit. The three-bar cooldown and short side are state/direction features not represented here.

strategy_roster.name: Double MA Crossover Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(20)/SMA(50) are explicit fallbacks for the unnamed fast/slow periods, and the prior 20-bar high break supplies the required confirmation. Pip protection, trailing modes, session limits, and the short side are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: TCPivot Stop
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(20) is a rolling pivot proxy because previous-day high/low/close and time fields are unavailable; its bullish and bearish crosses provide entry and exit. Classical support/resistance targets, 23:00 close, and stops are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: ASCPlusPlus
strategy_roster.notes: A prior ten-bar high break during below-average ATR(10) approximates the narrow-range breakout; the opposite range break exits. Williams %R, confirmation counters, stop-order offsets, and point-based protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: cm RSI
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) with 30/70 levels is an explicit fallback because the period and levels are not supplied; an upward cross enters and the opposite cross exits. Point-based protection, short entries, and the original RSI price source are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Target EA Manager
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy only manages floating PnL and pending orders and explicitly opens no trades. An impossible negative-price guard preserves that behavior instead of inventing a signal.

strategy_roster.name: Delta WPR
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R is unavailable; RSI(14) versus RSI(30) and the documented -50 regime are mapped to a positive oscillator regime proxy. The short side, exact WPR scaling, and 4-hour resampling are omitted.
